request.description:
Verifies the code and signs in. Creates the user on first sign-in, linking to an existing party (for example a lead) when the mobile matches exactly one person.

The session opens in the context chosen by `loginAs` at request time. Borrower memberships are created automatically. For `ca`, `dsa` or `lender` without an active membership, the session opens with context `none` and `nextAction` tells the client what to do next. Pending invitations for this mobile or email are accepted automatically.

Wrong codes return `attemptsLeft`; after 5 wrong attempts the code locks.
